node: Franchise royalty systems and unit-economics flywheel
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around scarce or underfollowed suppliers that can influence restaurant franchisee unit economics through procurement scale, approved-vendor access, beverage/coffee inputs, foodservice distribution, kitchen/service equipment, and supply-chain infrastructure. Reference leaders such as Domino's and Yum are useful context because they show why franchisors care about centralized procurement and system-level cost control, but the discovery lane is more interesting in small/mid-cap B2B suppliers such as Farmer Brothers and Westrock Coffee, plus foodservice supplier platforms whose economics may depend on franchisee capex, remodel cycles, and approved-product status.
